title: Session egress is limited to named hosts, not the public internet
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: Earlier Astra finding E6: t-jfg2npc limited mounts only; sessions still reach any public host.
Outcome: a sandboxed session reaches only the allowlisted hosts; a test proves an unlisted host is refused.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer fails before the fix and passes after.
